updates.background_zh: 加密货币上币（listing）指代币被加入交易所可交易资产列表的过程，上线后用户即可买卖或与其他币种交易。项目方通常会选择在代币生成事件（TGE）时安排多家交易所同步上币，以最大化市场曝光和流动性。Canopy 属于较新的 AI 相关基础设施方向之一，目标是让区块链开发体验更接近传统的后端编程。
updates.background_en: A cryptocurrency exchange listing refers to the process by which a token is added to a platform's tradeable assets; after being listed, users can buy, sell, or trade it against other currencies. Projects often time a multi-exchange launch to maximize simultaneous exposure and liquidity. Canopy is part of a newer wave of AI-focused infrastructure projects that aim to make blockchain development feel closer to conventional backend programming.
updates.market_impact_zh: CNPY 上线多家主流中心化交易所将扩大其潜在投资者基础，并提供更深的订单簿，从而吸引更多零售和量化交易者。影响主要通过流动性、分发渠道和市场情绪传导，最终市场表现仍取决于实际需求与整体行情。
updates.market_impact_en: Adding CNPY to several major centralized exchanges broadens its pool of potential investors and provides deeper order books, which can attract both retail and quantitative traders. The main transmission channels are distribution, liquidity, and market sentiment; the eventual market reaction will depend on actual demand and broader conditions.
